resetInProgress: The app is being reset. Try again shortly.

validationReasons.PREVIEW_DUPLICATE_FILE_IDS: The following items were selected more than once. Select the items again and preview:
validationReasons.PREVIEW_ITEMS_NOT_IN_DIRECTORY: The following items are not in the current directory. Reload the directory and select the items again:

codes.APPLICATION_ERROR: The app cannot complete this operation right now. Try again later; if the problem persists, restart the app.
codes.NOT_FOUND: This file or folder was not found. Refresh the directory and select it again.
codes.PROVIDER_ERROR: The storage service is temporarily unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
codes.AUTHENTICATION_ERROR: Account authorization is unavailable. Go to Settings to check the connection and authorize the account again.
codes.RATE_LIMIT_ERROR: Too many requests. Try again later.
codes.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to rename this item. Check access permissions or use an account with access.
codes.VALIDATION_ERROR: The operation could not be completed with the current input. Check the name and settings, then try again.
codes.REQUEST_VALIDATION_ERROR: Some information is missing or invalid. Check the entered information and try again.
codes.RULE_CONFIGURATION_ERROR: The rule settings are invalid. Check the values entered in the rules.
codes.RENAME_CONFLICT: An item with this name already exists in this directory. Change the new name and try again.
codes.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The preview is no longer valid. Refresh the preview.
codes.PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND: The preview was not found. Refresh the preview.
codes.STORAGE_BUSY: This connection is processing another operation. Wait for it to finish and try again.
codes.STORAGE_CONNECTION_CHANGED: The connection or account has changed. Refresh the directory and preview again.
codes.RENAME_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Some rename results are unconfirmed. Refresh the directory, or check the files at their source before running this operation again.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The app cannot complete this operation right now. Try again later; if the problem persists, restart the app.

readUnavailable: Could not read data. Check your network connection and that the app is running, then try again.
writeUnknown: Complete results were not received. Refresh the page and verify the current state before repeating the operation.

reasons.authorizationExpired: Account authorization has expired. Go to Settings and authorize the account again.
reasons.nameNull: The name cannot contain a null character. Remove it and try again.
reasons.nameEmpty: The name cannot be empty. Enter a new name.
reasons.nameDots: The name cannot be “.” or “..”. Use another name.
reasons.nameCharacters: Names cannot contain {{characters}} or control characters ({{control_characters}}). Remove them and try again.
reasons.nameEnding: The name cannot end with a space or period. Change it and try again.
reasons.nameReserved: This name is reserved by Windows. Use another name.
reasons.nameLength: Names cannot exceed {{max_length}} characters. Shorten the name and try again.
reasons.pathLength: The full path after renaming exceeds {{max_length}} characters. Shorten the name.
reasons.oneDriveStart: OneDrive names cannot start with {{prefixes}}. Change the name and try again.
reasons.oneDriveFolderStart: OneDrive folder names cannot start with {{prefixes}}. Change the name and try again.
reasons.oneDriveReserved: This name is reserved by OneDrive. Use another name.
reasons.oneDriveForms: The name “{{name}}” is reserved at the OneDrive root. Use another name.
reasons.googleShortcut: This app cannot rename Google Drive shortcuts. Rename the shortcut in Google Drive.
reasons.symbolicLink: This app cannot access symbolic links or directory junctions. Select the actual folder.
reasons.connectionMissing: This connection was not found. Select another connection.
reasons.accountDisconnected: No account is connected. Go to Settings to authorize an account.
reasons.fileChanged: The file has changed. Refresh the directory and try again.
reasons.renameUnsupported: This file source does not support renaming.
reasons.itemRenameUnavailable: This item cannot be renamed due to possible access permission or application restrictions.
reasons.duplicateNames: New names are duplicated or already in use. Adjust the rules and refresh the preview.
reasons.rootRename: The storage root cannot be renamed. Select an item inside it.
reasons.outsideRoot: This location is outside the allowed directory. Select a folder within the connection directory.
reasons.defaultConnection: The default local connection cannot be deleted. Select another connection.
reasons.connectionNameEmpty: The connection name cannot be empty.
reasons.connectionNameLength: The connection name cannot exceed 200 characters.
